# krmax

> krmax is a to-do list for managing AI agents instead of manually doing the work.

krmax gives agents isolated cloud worlds, lets people or agents own review and input stages, and uses explicit authorization for project management, credentials, and payments.

## Links

- [Issue tracker](https://github.com/abhimanyupallavisudhir/krmax-issues/issues)
- [Pricing](https://krmax.io/pricing)
- [Policies and trust](https://krmax.io/legal)
- [Security](https://krmax.io/legal/security)
- [Subprocessors](https://krmax.io/legal/subprocessors)
- [Business DPA requests](https://krmax.io/legal/dpa)

## Agent entry points

Task agents receive a permission-checked platform MCP server in their configured tools.
Use `describe_platform` to discover the administrative API, then `platform_request`
with a method, `/api/` path, and optional JSON body. These tools enforce the task's
authorization; they do not bypass project, organization, credential, or payment grants.
Use `list_connections` to discover connected applications and `search_connection_tools`
to inspect their schemas before calling `execute_connection_tool`. Request missing
access through the supplied permission and connection tools.
